reviews.name: Jule
reviews.quote: We hosted our rehearsal dinner here (catered by Cindy's Deli!) and had our reception here the next day. It was perfect! Natural industrial beauty without much decor or set up needed besides some centerpieces! The price was extremely reasonable for a wedding on a budget, and I would recommend TrailSide a million times over!

reviews.name: Shane
reviews.quote: It is really big for our wedding really like the place it is really nice

reviews.name: Dawn
reviews.quote: Had an amazing time at our wedding reception..space is beautiful and easily personalized…owners are great to work with!

reviews.name: Tricia
reviews.quote: I absolutely LOVE this venue! It creates the perfect vibe for any event! Working with Jordan was a breeze! She made sure everything was ready for the event and super easy to communicate with. I highly recommend TrailSide Events PA for your next big (or small) celebration 🎉

reviews.name: Josch
reviews.quote: Perfect cozy venue for any occasion. The owner and staff made my special day feel extra special with their care and attention. Held my wedding there and all the guests commented about how nice the place was. 10/10*

reviews.name: Maris
reviews.quote: We recently hosted our 10-year high school reunion at Trailside Events PA and it was great! The venue was perfect for our gathering, offering a spacious setting and easily accessible location that comfortably accommodated all our guests. Highly recommend this venue for events!

reviews.name: Robin
reviews.quote: I recently had the pleasure of working with TrailSide Events, and I cannot say enough good things about this venue. The owners are an absolute joy to work with. Their communication was always prompt and clear, making the planning process smooth and stress-free. The venue itself is stunning, and there is SO much space! What really stood out was the level of support I received throughout. The owners went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect, and their attention to detail and willingness to accommodate my needs made the experience truly exceptional. I highly recommend TrailSide Events for anyone looking for a beautiful venue with incredible service. It’s clear the owners genuinely care about making your event special, and I am so grateful for all their help!

reviews.name: Brittney
reviews.quote: We hosted an event at Trailside and were blown away by the experience. The venue is beautiful, clean, and versatile, and the staff were exceptionally professional and helpful. Everything went smoothly, and our guests were thrilled. Highly recommend this space for any occasion!

reviews.name: Kaitlyn
reviews.quote: Absolutely beautiful venue for absolutely any occasion! Newly renovated venue with beautiful architecture. Full length bar with large gathering areas. Owners communicate very well with renters and offer many great packages. Can’t go wrong with booking any event!
